records.name: Bert Craterfill
records.biography_en: The tile broke on its own. He wanted this noted before they authorized its next orbit.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The tile broke on its own. He wanted this noted before they authorized its next orbit.

records.name: Iris Gasketear
records.biography_en: The gasket was making a tiny statement about the pressure schedule. Iris asked for a second reading.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The gasket was making a tiny statement about the pressure schedule. Iris asked for a second reading.

records.name: Cal Upbend
records.biography_en: The drop was leaving through a perfectly good inlet. Cal marked it as an ambition problem.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The drop was leaving through a perfectly good inlet. Cal marked it as an ambition problem.

records.name: Vera Wipewing
records.biography_en: She wiped off a comet streak and found a second one in exactly the same place. The sun had been taking notes.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: She wiped off a comet streak and found a second one in exactly the same place. The sun had been taking notes.

records.name: Len Moonmeter
records.biography_en: The meter showed a crescent. Len asked whether we intended to pay for the missing part.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The meter showed a crescent. Len asked whether we intended to pay for the missing part.

records.name: Dex Sparksnip
records.biography_en: Dex joined two cables that had been avoiding each other for years. Their first conversation was quite brief.
